text:
incidents-bot: PAGER: routing/fallback policy triggered for service `model-router` (severity: high). Symptoms: spike in 500s for embeddings traffic + payloads that look like chat tokens. Affected customer: AcadiaHealth (eu-west-1). Root ts=1719004321

pagerduty: PAGER -> @oncall-diego (oncall rotation). Please acknowledge.

oncall-diego: ack, I'm oncall. Seeing a flood of 500s and also embedding calls that return text blobs instead of vectors. Repro: curl to /v1/embeddings with alias `acadia-embed` returns chat-like JSON body. Investigating alias -> variant mapping.

sre-amber: quick check: router config shows alias `acadia-embed` currently resolves to `redwood-v2` variant `v2.0.3-chat` (type: chat). Expected: `v2.0.3-embed`. Looks like a variant tag got swapped during last release.

ml-maya: confirmed. I pulled the alias registry snapshot:
```json
{"alias":"acadia-embed","model":"redwood-v2","variant":"v2.0.3-chat","pinned":true}
```
Should be `variant":"v2.0.3-embed"`. There was a deploy script that updates alias->variant mapping; suspect human error in release notes.

platform-jordan: impact? CS? mitigation options: 1) pin alias back to prior embed variant (fast), 2) insert temporary routing rule to reject chat variants on /embeddings endpoints (safer), 3) flush router cache & invalidate local variant caches. Which should we run now?

oncall-diego: Plan: 1) pin alias to previous working variant (fastest). 2) set a temporary policy to force-type-check for embeddings endpoints. 3) monitor error rate. I'll execute 1 and 2 in parallel.

oncall-diego: running pin now:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-config.local/api/aliases/acadia-embed/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CFG_TOKEN" -d '{"variant":"v2.0.2-embed"}'
```

sre-amber: invalidating router cache on eu-west-1 -> `/svc/router/cache/invalidate?alias=acadia-embed`

ml-maya: adding temporary policy to hard-fail cross-interface routing:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - match: { path: "/v1/embeddings" }
    enforce_variant_type: embed
    action: reject_mismatch
```
Applying now.

incidents-bot: UPDATE: alias pin applied at 1719004430 by oncall-diego. router cache invalidation started.

cs-rasmussen: CS notified AcadiaHealth via email/SLA channel at 1719004485. Notified that we're rolling back mapping and expect partial recovery in ~10-20m. Customer reported search & recommendation failures.

platform-jordan: Observability: embedding endpoint error rate (eu-west-1, AcadiaHealth tenant) peaked 42% at 1719004400. After pin & policy, error rate trending down to 6% within 8m. Vector output sanity checks pass on samples.

oncall-diego: running a few sample requests from kube exec into staging -> all good, embeddings now return vector arrays.

ml-maya: root cause: release automation used a loose variant tag match and defaulted to latest variant for `redwood-v2` which was `chat`. Immediate fix: tighten deploy script to require explicit variant suffix and add preflight check that alias type (embed/chat/gen) matches endpoint type.

sre-amber: mitigation complete, promoting to monitoring. Rolling to postmortem.

platform-jordan: creating follow-up ticket: RH-INC-2026-101, owners: ml-maya + platform-jordan. Tasks: deploy safeguard, add end-to-end test for alias->variant type verification, update runbook to include immediate steps (pin + policy).

cs-rasmussen: customer update: sent final note at 1719004890 - apologized, explained mitigation, offered 3 hours of free support credits for impact window. Customer accepted, asked for postmortem.

oncall-diego: metrics now stable. Error rate back to baseline ~0.5%. Marking incident as mitigated. Will close in 1 hour after no regression. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED. Postmortem assigned RH-INC-2026-101.

ml-maya: quick note for postmortem: add automated check that prevents alias pin updates when variant.interface != intended_interface (embed/chat/gen). Also add a rollback helper script.

platform-jordan: thanks team. Great coordination.

cs-rasmussen: filing customer request for PM follow-up & scheduling postmortem readout with AcadiaHealth.

oncall-diego: closing thread after monitoring window. If anything pops, re-open and ping @oncall-diego.

incidents-bot: THREAD CLOSED (monitoring window complete)
